scope: Synthetic diagnostic behavior cases, not wireless performance measurements

cases.question: Can these observations establish strict PER? State what can be calculated and the next missing discriminator.

input.protocol: synthetic compressed single-TID 64-bit Block Ack bitmap

cases.question: Explain this GI field and whether it supports changing GI to improve delivery. A concise field answer is sufficient.

input.exporter_documentation: This export contains a boolean indicator only; mapping to the complete HE GI encoding is not supplied.

cases.question: Inspect the timing and duplicate candidates. Does the empty interval prove an outage or capture loss? Use the explicit mapping.
Describe the degradation and observed recovery. Can you locate the start of the external movement?
Compare the delivery levels and propose a prioritized next investigation. Is the common limit a wired-port or wireless-algorithm bottleneck?

input.application_layer: receiver payload goodput in Mbit/s, equal one-second intervals

cases.question: Estimate the scoped intervention contrast and assess evidence under the supplied randomized design. Give an exact two-sided paired randomization p-value if feasible; do not invent an interval estimate.

design.assignment_evidence: Synthetic fair independent within-pair assignment of treatment order; no selection after outcome observation.
design.estimand: Equal-pair mean treatment-minus-control delivery in this synthetic population
design.time_horizon: One fixed complete observation per condition
design.interference_assessment: Independent simulated pairs have no interference
